summary: Adds new cipher suites to Transport Layer Security (TLS) that use the Camellia block cipher for encrypting data. This lets TLS clients and servers choose Camellia as an alternative to other bulk ciphers. It is a standards-track document, later replaced by RFC 5932.

eli5.summary: When two computers whisper secrets, they need to agree on a secret code. This memo adds one more code, called Camellia, to the list they can pick from.
